No outbound row with an Indian port of loading, foreign destination and export B/L number was visible in the free view. Indirect export signal only: the 'Buyers' block lists foreign counterparties ("SHRESTHA COMPANY PVT LTD ... Bhairawa, NEPAL", "TECHNICAL SUPPLIES SERVICES CO. ... DOHA, QATAR"), which is consistent with exports but is not a dated shipment record. domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. No domestic supply record was seen, and none is asserted.
note: Company is a real, active Kolkata (4 Fairlie Place) entity with a live customs footprint — 5825 records, 34 trading partners, 25 ports, latest cargo 2026-02-28 — but the free ImportKey view exposes only import transactions (HS 73182990, 73181500, 85389000, 84669390, 84669390), i.e. it is buying machine-tool spares from OSL Cutting Technologies (UK/China-origin) rather than demonstrably shipping out. Declared HS 820770/846719 (milling/drilling & tapping tools) is consistent with the tooling business but was NOT matched to any observed shipment line, so it stays unverified rather than corrected. Export status is therefore 'declared_only': foreign buyers appear in the counterparty list, yet no dated export B/L with destination and HS code was actually seen. Domestic supply: no evidence either way — 'unknown', not 'none_found', because the registries that would carry GST turnover and tender data were all blocked. Per Rule 5 this is not a soft 'conditionally accepted': there are no confirmed shipments in either direction, only imports. Recommend re-running with paid Volza/Eximpedia export views or the company's own GST/AR data before any supply decision.
